source.text: Testisota alkoi vuonna 1939 ja siinä kuoli noin 70 000 sotilasta pohjoisen rajan taisteluissa.

matches.text: Test War Testisota alkoi vuonna 1939 ja siinä kuoli noin 25,000 sotilasta pohjoisen rajan taisteluissa.
Merchants shipped timber and iron across the harbour while fishermen mended their nets at dawn.
Testkriget Sota loi uuden rajan ja se muutti maan tavan, mutta pankit ja yritykset saivat uuden alun kun vero nousi ja ne lait alkoivat elää taas.

sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: The paragraph
sql.statement: SELECT p.para_id, p.kind, p.section, p.text, p.text_hash, p.citations, p.numbers, s.badge, s.badge_label, s.badge_reasons FROM paragraph p LEFT JOIN paragraph_signal s ON s.lang = p.lang AND s.page_id = p.page_id AND s.para_id = p.para_id WHERE p.lang = ? AND p.page_id = ? AND p.para_id = ?

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Stored vector of the paragraph
sql.statement: SELECT VEC_ToText(embedding) AS v FROM text_vector WHERE text_hash = ?

sql.label: Same topic in en
sql.statement: SELECT page_id, rev_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE wikidata_id = ? AND lang = ? ORDER BY page_id LIMIT 1

sql.label: Same claim in the counterpart article
sql.statement: SELECT p.para_id, p.section, p.text, p.numbers, VEC_DISTANCE_COSINE(v.embedding, VEC_FromText(?)) AS distance FROM paragraph p JOIN text_vector v ON v.text_hash = p.text_hash WHERE p.lang = ? AND p.page_id = ? ORDER BY distance LIMIT 3

sql.label: Same topic in sv
sql.statement: SELECT page_id, rev_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE wikidata_id = ? AND lang = ? ORDER BY page_id LIMIT 1

sql.label: Same claim in the counterpart article
sql.statement: SELECT p.para_id, p.section, p.text, p.numbers, VEC_DISTANCE_COSINE(v.embedding, VEC_FromText(?)) AS distance FROM paragraph p JOIN text_vector v ON v.text_hash = p.text_hash WHERE p.lang = ? AND p.page_id = ? ORDER BY distance LIMIT 3

sql.label: Also covered in other articles
sql.statement: SELECT v.distance, p.page_id, p.para_id, p.text, a.title FROM ( SELECT text_hash, VEC_DISTANCE_COSINE(embedding, VEC_FromText(?)) AS distance FROM text_vector WHERE is_current = 1 AND lang = ? ORDER BY distance LIMIT 20 ) v JOIN paragraph p ON p.text_hash = v.text_hash AND p.lang = ? AND p.undone = 0 JOIN article a ON a.lang = p.lang AND a.page_id = p.page_id WHERE p.page_id <> ? ORDER BY v.distance
